sub: Object storage for any file, with 11 nines durability

Overview.p: Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) stores files as objects inside buckets. It is highly durable (99.999999999%), scales without limit and you pay only for what you store and transfer.
A huge online locker. Each file gets its own link. You decide who can open it, and you never worry about disk space.
A news site keeps all images and videos in S3, serves them through CloudFront, and moves old articles to Glacier to save cost.

What is S3 and how is it different from EBS?
S3 is object storage accessed over HTTP. EBS is a block disk attached to one EC2 instance.
What does 11 nines durability mean?
99.999999999% durability: the chance of losing an object is extremely small because data is stored across multiple AZs.
How do you make an S3 bucket private?
Keep Block Public Access on, use IAM or bucket policies, and avoid public ACLs.
What is versioning?
It keeps every version of an object so you can restore after an overwrite or delete.
Which storage class for rarely used data?
Standard-IA or Glacier depending on how fast you need it back. Use lifecycle rules to move automatically.
Can S3 host a website?
Yes, static sites only. Use CloudFront in front for HTTPS.
What is a presigned URL?
A temporary link that gives time-limited access to a private object.
Bucket names are globally unique
